name: Orientognathus
sum: Rhamphorhynchid from the Late Jurassic Tuchengzi Formation of Liaoning, China.
holotype: Single specimen — Tuchengzi Formation, Liaoning (Lü et al. 2015).
material: Most of the skeleton and skull.
biology: A basal rhamphorhynchid, slightly younger than the Tiaojishan fauna.
author: Lu et al. 2015

species.name: Orientognathus chaoyangensis
species.author: Lu et al. 2015
species.ref: J. Lu, H. Pu, and X. Wei, H. Chang, M. Kundrat. 2015. A new rhamphorhynchid pterosaur (Pterosauria) from Jurassic deposits of Liaoning Province, China. Zootaxa 3911(1):119-129
